|strategy=By Paul Evans<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/aksmoe.html</ref>

With a politics of 3 and an agenda of ambition and blockade, [[Aks Moe]] is a staple in any Dark Side deck seeking control of the Galactic Senate. [[Aks Moe]]'s ability to add 2 to power of each of your capitals exhibits his senatorial power which strengthens the Trade Federation fleet as well as the already massive Imperial Fleet, leaving the Light Side to think twice before taking on a fleet of the Emperor's finest. [[Aks Moe]] furthers his influence by benefiting those willing to play a balanced deck by adding to drains at a system where you occupy a related site. Not only does this help the Dark Side, but it also could prove to punish the current giants for the Light Side: [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation{{!}}Quiet Mining Colony]], [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed{{!}}Rebel Strike Team]], and [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough{{!}}Watch Your Step]]. [[Aks Moe]] proves to be a mighty senator and all this for just 2 Force.
